The commission has also maintained a reserve list of 258 candidates. The results remain subject to verification of reservation claims and other eligibility conditions.
title: UPSC CSE 2025 final result out: 958 recommended for civil services

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: Around two-thirds of India’s LPG demand is met through imports, with the Middle East accounting for roughly 85 to 90 per cent of those supplies. Oil refiners have been told to maximise LPG output by ensuring that the propane and butane available with them are fully utilised for cooking gas production, the report said.
title: US-Iran war impact: India asks refiners to step up LPG output to avoid cooking gas shortage - report

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: President Trump indicated the U.S. may shift its focus to Cuba after resolving the situation in Iran. He praised Senator Marco Rubio's work on Cuba, suggesting a future return for "unbelievable people." This comes as Cuba faces an energy blockade, exacerbating its economic crisis.
title: 'Want to finish this one first': After Iran and Venezuela, Trump hints Cuba could be next

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: Watch: 50 Israeli jets destroy Khamenei's bunker in Tehran

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: The Israeli Defense Forces conducted a significant overnight strike in Beirut, targeting Hezbollah's headquarters and military infrastructure within a densely populated area. This action, described as the twenty-sixth wave of strikes, followed Hezbollah's alleged violation of a truce and its involvement in opening a new front in the ongoing conflict.
title: Watch: Israel shares video of precision strikes in Beirut; Hezbollah's military infrastructure hit

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: The Middle East conflict intensifies as it enters its seventh day. United States forces conduct precision strikes on Iranian assets. Israel launches new attacks targeting regime infrastructure. Missile launches from Iran trigger air-raid alerts in Israel. Gulf nations report drone and missile threats. Humanitarian concerns rise with displacement and casualties.
title: Watch: US rains precision strikes on Iran as Middle East war enters Day 7

author: APEKSHA TANWAR
description: The Union Public Service Commission has announced the Civil Services Examination 2025 final results, recommending 958 candidates for the Indian Administrative Service, Indian Foreign Service, Indian Police Service and other central services. Anuj Agnihotri from Rawatbhata in Rajasthan secured Rank 1. A medical graduate from AIIMS Jodhpur, he began civil services preparation after completing his internship in 2023.
title: Who is Anuj Agnihotri, the UPSC CSE 2025 topper?

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Despite a costly outing in the semifinal, India's team management and senior players back mystery spinner Varun Chakravarthy as their potential match-winner for the T20 World Cup final.  Vice-captain Axar Patel emphasised the importance of mental strength and trusting his plans, believing Varun Chakravarthy can still deliver a crucial performance.
title: ‘You are the X-factor’: Team India backs Varun Chakravarthy ahead of final

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Sanju Samson's explosive 89 powered India to the T20 World Cup final against England. This stellar knock marks a significant personal comeback after a period of uncertainty. Samson, who also scored 97 in the previous match, emphasised the importance of patience and focusing on basics, even stepping away from social media to regain his form.
title: ‘One more match’: Samson eyes another big knock in India’s summit clash vs NZ

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Iran's IRGC claims its latest "Operation True Promise-4" attacks bypassed US THAAD missile defence, targeting Israeli sites. Despite leadership losses, Iran continues strikes across the Middle East, straining Western air defence systems like THAAD, Patriot, and Standard Missiles. These vital interceptors are already depleted by aid to Ukraine and Red Sea deployments
title: What is THAAD? The US missile defence system with ‘hit-to-kill’ tech playing big role in Iran war

author: TOI CITY DESK
description: Karnataka Chief Minister Siddaramaiah announced plans for a social media ban for children under 16 while presenting the 2026-27 state budget. He also criticized the central government for its alleged injustice to the state and urged greater sensitivity to Karnataka's demands, highlighting the state's leading role in national development and tax contributions.
title: Karnataka govt announces social media ban for children under age of 16

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: The Strait of Hormuz, a vital shipping lane, is now a vulnerable point for undersea internet cables due to escalating West Asian tensions. Disruptions have halted crucial repair operations, impacting internet traffic and India's data center ambitions. This geopolitical flashpoint challenges previous perceptions of the route's safety.
title: Middle East crisis: Strait of Hormuz tensions add risks for subsea cables critical to India’s data flows

title: Left to fend for themselves? Gulf allies claim US gave no warning before strikes

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Salesforce leadership addressed internal unrest following CEO Marc Benioff's controversial jokes about ICE targeting international employees. Company president Robin Washington acknowledged employee feedback, assuring them their concerns were heard and adjustments are being made. Co-founder Parker Harris also publicly condemned the remarks, emphasizing the company's commitment to its employees.
title: Salesforce President responds to CEO's ICE jokes that upset employees

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Oracle is reportedly planning significant job cuts, potentially thousands, to manage a growing cash crunch fueled by its massive AI data center expansion. This restructuring, costing over $1.6 billion, aims to address financial pressures from a $300 billion OpenAI partnership. The company's stock has seen a substantial decline as Wall Street scrutinizes its aggressive spending and debt.
title: Oracle layoffs may go up to 30,000 as company faces cash crunch to meet OpenAI commitment

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: Stock market today: BSE Sensex closed at 78,918.90, down 1,097 points or 1.37%. Investors reacted to intensifying tensions involving the United States, Israel and Iran.
title: Market crash: Sensex down nearly 1,100 points - top reasons for fall

author: TNN
description: JD(U) workers protested outside CM Nitish Kumar's residence and party office, expressing anger and disbelief over his Rajya Sabha nomination. Alleging a conspiracy and pressure, some threatened self-immolation and vandalized property, demanding to meet their leader and questioning the authenticity of his social media posts.
title: Nitish Kumar’s RS nomination: JDU workers vandalise office, allege BJP plot

author: SAMDANI MN
description: In a groundbreaking move, Andhra Pradesh is introducing an innovative population growth initiative aimed at encouraging families to expand. The state government will provide ₹25,000 and complimentary education through high school for families welcoming a third child, as well as covering IVF costs and offering longer parental leave.
title: 25k for 3rd child: Andhra unveils India's first draft population management policy

author: ANKUR TEWARI
description: News of Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei's assassination has deeply affected Barabanki, India, the ancestral village of his predecessor Khomeini. Residents expressed sorrow and anger, with protests against the US and Israel erupting. Khamenei's great-grandfather, Sayed Ahmad Musavi 'Hindi', originated from Kintoor village before migrating to Iran.
title: A somber mood in Khomeini’s ancestral village in UP

author: TNN
description: A shocking incident unfolded in Damoh where a 16-year-old boy was brutally murdered. Eyewitnesses claim the accused then engaged in cannibalistic acts. Police have arrested the suspect, who has a prior murder conviction. The investigation into the motive behind this horrific crime is ongoing. The victim's body has been sent for postmortem.
title: MP horror: Man bludgeons 16-year-old boy to death with hammer, eats his flesh and drinks blood
